components.name: Well-founded finite stabilization completion
components.project_addition: Formalize that ordinary finite iteration of a monotone reductive endomap on a well-founded partial order reaches the greatest original fixed point below the initial state, then package that finite stabilization as a monotone reductive idempotent operator with the same fixed points and connect it to the P008 interior/coreflection viewpoint and P019 collapse-word dynamics.
